IP printing: QZ Tray required · browser print available
🔗 Print Relay Link — for phones, iPhone & any device without QZ Tray
Not set
Install the relay once on an always-on PC on the printer Wi-Fi (copy the one setup file below to that PC and double-click it). Then press Find relay link — the link and key appear here, ready to copy or send to staff phones.
📱 Steward phone link (opens the app with the relay already set)
⬇ Setup files:
Where do I find the link?
1. On the relay PC, the black relay window prints App address (https site): https://192.168.x.x:9191 — that is the link.
2. Window closed? Run start-relay.bat again, or on that PC press Find relay link here.
3. Otherwise: relay PC → Command Prompt → ipconfig → IPv4 address → type https://IPv4:9191.
4. Check from a phone on the same Wi-Fi: open https://IPv4:9191/health (Android: Advanced → Proceed).
🔐 QZ Tray trust — stop the “Untrusted website” popup (one-time per PC)
1. and copy it into the QZ Tray folder (usually C:\Program Files\QZ Tray).
2. Paste the private key text (from qz-private-key.pem) below and press Save.
3. Quit QZ Tray from the tray icon, start it again, reload this page, then press Retry IP Printers.
Keep the private key private — it is stored only in this browser and never sent anywhere. Quick fix without this: in the QZ popup untick “Remember this decision” and click Allow.

Data Tools
Master data management and bulk imports — moved here to keep the main menu focused on daily operations. Sales reports (DSR, Monthly) are under Reports Hub.
🗂️ Master Hub
Menu, recipes, staff, suppliers, tables — all master categories in one place
📥 Import Hub
Upload Excel exports — POS data, purchase register, bank statements
🔌 POS Integration Mode
Once real POS exports are being uploaded through Import Hub regularly, turn this ON — Daily Collection and Guest Net Dues then take their numbers from those uploads instead, and the manual "+ Add Entry" buttons switch off to prevent double-entry. Turn it back OFF any time to combine manual entries with POS data again.
☢️ Reset All Data
Clears every local setting and transaction on this device: bill-number sequence, Day Open/Close status, open KOTs, held bills, the local Bill Register, any menu items added locally, theme/display preferences, paper size, and every other local setting — this device goes back to a blank first-install state. This does NOT touch your Google Sheets database. Use this before going live, or when handing the device to a brand-new client.
🧪 Clear Database Test Data
For the go-live test cycle: enter some real transactions, check the reports actually reflect them, then use this to wipe the test rows in the actual database (Sales, Sales Items, Guest Dues, Daily Collection, Bank Sweep, Bank Statement, Online Aggregator) before testing again or handing over for real. Unlike the two resets above, this does reach the Google Sheets database — Master Hub data (Menu, Staff, Tables, etc.) is not touched.

Steward Incentive

Item-group wise incentive · rules · bill-wise proof

Incentive Rules
Item Group-wise Incentive
Every menu group is listed above — type a value to give that whole group its own incentive (% of amount, or ₹ per qty). Leave blank to follow the Food / Bar / Others % above. Priority: single item rule → group rule → Food / Bar / Others %. NC and cancelled bills earn nothing. Bill discounts reduce the amount first.
Item-wise Incentive
An item listed here is paid by its own rule only (it is removed from the Food / Bar / Others % above). Items not listed follow the group %. Flat ₹ is multiplied by quantity sold. Click Edit to change, or Remove to send the item back to its group %.
